subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Manila to Chongqing on Air China and travel to Dujiangyan, where you visit Panda Park and enjoy a 2-hour ski session at Zhegu Mountain. Then continue to Chengdu and back to Chongqing for Liziba Station, Jiefangbei, Hongya Cave at night and Ciqikou Ancient Town. Hotels are local 5-star, with a private coach and an English-speaking guide.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 4–8 2026 to Feb 23–27 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Panda Park: A giant panda conservation and viewing park near Dujiangyan; a battery bus is included.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old walled town of Dujiangyan with traditional streets, shops and local snacks.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square: A central square in Dujiangyan where the tour stops for a photo with the panda statue.
placeDesc.Zhegu Mountain Ski Resort: A ski resort in the mountains near Dujiangyan; this tour includes a 2-hour skiing session with equipment.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge: A well-known bookstore in Sichuan with mirrored, eye-catching interior design.
placeDesc.Science and Technology Museum: A science and technology museum in the Chengdu area, visited as a city stop.
placeDesc.Broad and Narrow Alley: A historic district in Chengdu of traditional courtyards, teahouses and shops.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping and dining complex in central Chengdu with ancient-temple surroundings.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: Chengdu's main downtown pedestrian shopping street.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light-rail station where the train runs through a residential building, a famous photo spot.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: Chongqing's central pedestrian shopping district with a landmark monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street known for local food, where meals are at your own expense.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stilted riverside building complex in Chongqing, famous for its night view.
placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A historic riverside old town in Chongqing with stone lanes, teahouses and craft stalls.
placeDesc.The Ring Shopping Park: A shopping complex in Chongqing, visited before the airport transfer.
